context: Two managers prep an annual research kickoff
purpose: Teach: 上級/入試/リサーチ/ミッション/やり取り/持参/拡充/リストラ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: リサーチの上級モジュール、今期から導入したい。
lines.en: We want to roll out the advanced research module starting this term.
lines.style: Crisp, forward-leaning. Direct eye contact. Light emphasis on 「導入したい」—ownership and intention. No hesitation. Brisk pace, shoulders engaged.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。入試マーケットへの応用も含めて、ミッションを定めます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll define the mission, including how it applies to the entrance-exam market.
lines.style: Immediate and aligned. Slight nod of agreement on the opening. Warm professionalism—not stiff. Steady pace. Takes the ball and moves it forward without slowing down.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 顧客とのやり取り、形式も拡充しよう。
lines.en: And let's expand the formats for how we interact with clients.
lines.style: Building on the momentum. Light emphasis on 「形式」—this is the detail that matters. Measured pace. Looking for buy-in but confident in the direction. Slight lean forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 提案書、持参形式で訪問先にも回ります。
lines.en: I'll bring proposals in hand and run them through the visits personally.
lines.style: Concrete and practical. Slight ownership in the voice—not offering, confirming. Steady, reliable tone. Medium pace. This is the 「how」—stated cleanly, no drama.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: リストラ騒動が落ち着く前に、計画を確定させたい。
lines.en: I want to lock down the plan before the restructuring talk dies down.
lines.style: Quiet urgency underneath. Emphasis on the window closing—this matters. Not panicked, but aware. Steady gaze. Slight tightness in the tempo. The stakes are implied.
